exceptions.title: does not link Select.Label before hydration
exceptions.reason: The case renders on a server only. Vase UI links the label in the server HTML (VUE-51). The block "VUE-51: a label of the select" asserts `aria-labelledby` in the server HTML, with the label before and after the trigger.

exceptions.title: highlights an item on mouse move by default
exceptions.reason: WebKit sends a `mousemove` with no movement when a list scrolls under a pointer that does not move. In WebKit, the list navigation thus ignores a `mousemove` with no movement, and the hover of user-event sends one.

exceptions.title: does not dismiss when pressing portalled content inside the popup but outside the list
exceptions.reason: The case presses a plain element in a portal in the popup. Vue gives that event to no listener of the popup element, so that element is outside the popup. A press in a child popup that `Teleport` moved is inside (`VUE-4`). The case "VUE-4: a press in a child popup that Teleport moved does not close the parent popup" tests that press.

exceptions.title: should select the item and close popup when clicked
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Select.Item` in `Select.Positioner` with no `Select.Popup`. The popup root unmounts after the exit animations of the popup element, so with no popup element the positioner stays mounted and visible after the close. The case "selects the item with a click and hides the positioner after the popup closes" renders the popup.

exceptions.title: should highlight a hovered item and commit it with a mouse click
exceptions.reason: WebKit sends a `mousemove` with no movement when a list scrolls under a pointer that does not move. In WebKit, the list navigation thus ignores a `mousemove` with no movement, and the case dispatches one.

exceptions.title: does not resize the positioner when the list scrolls before the popup is placed
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Select.ScrollUpArrow`, which Vase UI does not have.

exceptions.title: synchronizes an updated disabled prop after descendant ref callbacks
exceptions.reason: Vue writes the props of the root to the store before the items render, so a click in the `ref` callback of that render does not select the item. The case "gives a new disabled prop of the root to the items in the render that changes it" asserts this.
